major_cooldowns.name: Apotheosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to reset and cheapen your Holy Words; as Archon always pair it with Halo, and enter with at least one Holy Word: Serenity and one Holy Word: Sanctify charge ready so every global during the window casts or reduces a Holy Word.

major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Archon use Halo early as raid damage lands, ideally inside the Apotheosis window, to apply the 10-second amplified-healing buff to your allies; pool Holy Words to benefit from the bonus healing without capping charges.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Hymn
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save for heavy raid-wide damage spikes; it can be channeled while line-of-sight of allies and deals bonus healing in Mythic+, so use it freely as a throughput cooldown in dungeons.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Word
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast immediately before the matching Holy Word to empower it; the Chastise build syncs Divine Word with Holy Word: Chastise (and Empyreal Blaze if talented) to enter Divine Favor: Chastise for a damage window.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Chastise
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep on cooldown for damage and to trigger Divine Favor: Chastise when buffed by Divine Word; Apotheosis can reset it for back-to-back Divine Word windows.

major_cooldowns.name: Empyreal Blaze
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast just before Divine Word so you spend no global on a non-damage cast inside the buff window; it also extends Holy Fire, so weave it on cooldown when talented.

defensives.name: Guardian Spirit
defensives.usage_rule: Use as your main tank external to prevent a lethal hit (cheat death restoring the target to 40% health); coordinate with the tank, and self-cast it if no tank needs it since Priest is otherwise weak defensively.

defensives.name: Desperate Prayer
defensives.usage_rule: Press when your health drops toward 75% or below, especially after self-damage like Shadow Word: Death, to instantly heal yourself and raise your maximum health for the window.

defensives.name: Fade
defensives.usage_rule: Use to shed threat and, with the Greater Fade or damage-reduction talents, to mitigate an incoming hit or shrug off a mechanic; keep it available for emergencies.

rules.description: Pair Halo with Apotheosis as Archon
rules.action: As Archon, cast Halo inside the Apotheosis window so both spells benefit from the bonus healing; using Halo outside Apotheosis sacrifices a large chunk of your focused output.
Cast Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify as they come up rather than sitting on charges; only pool a single Serenity charge when you know predictable burst damage is about to hit.

rules.description: Enter Apotheosis with Holy Words ready
rules.action: Hold a Holy Word: Serenity charge and a Holy Word: Sanctify charge as Apotheosis approaches so you enter the window with both ready, then spend and regenerate Holy Words aggressively for its full duration.

rules.description: Sync Divine Word with Holy Word: Chastise
rules.action: On the Chastise build, cast Divine Word immediately before Holy Word: Chastise (with Empyreal Blaze pre-cast if talented) to enter Divine Favor: Chastise; a Divine Word that does not feed a Holy Word is wasted.

rules.description: Maximize Holy Word casts in Apotheosis
rules.action: During Apotheosis, make every global cast a spell that either casts a Holy Word or reduces one (Flash Heal, Prayer of Healing, Smite); pre-pool Surge of Light procs so you can chain new Holy Words instead of idling.

rules.description: Spend Surge of Light on Prayer of Healing
rules.action: Consume Surge of Light procs with Prayer of Healing whenever possible for extra cooldown reduction; you may hold up to two stacks but avoid overcapping and wasting the free casts.
When a mechanic forces you behind a wall, keep channeling Divine Hymn since it heals allies even while you are line-of-sight of dangerous mobs; do not cancel it just to reposition.

source_summary: Holy Priest runs a priority list rather than a strict rotation, centered on keeping Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify on cooldown and feeding them through Apotheosis. As Archon, Apotheosis and Halo are used together as a paired throughput burst, entered with Holy Words pooled so every global generates or spends one; the Chastise build instead syncs Divine Word with Holy Word: Chastise (and Empyreal Blaze) for recurring Divine Favor windows. Divine Hymn is the emergency raid cooldown and Guardian Spirit the primary external, while between windows you pool Surge of Light procs and Holy Word charges to prepare for predictable damage.
